gate_findings.evidence: Task khai required_gates=[] va claim_ceiling=IDEA, nen khong co physics gate bat buoc. Reviewer van xac minh nen design basis: docs/design_basis/creative_frame_adapter_basis.json (basis_id CREATIVE-FRAME-ADAPTER-1.0.0) khai don vi qua frame model, edge_kind_mapping, support_policy, load_transfer method HALF_ADJACENT_DECK_EDGE_LENGTH_TO_EACH_END_NODE huong GLOBAL_NEGATIVE_Y voi relative_tolerance 1e-12, va minimum_element_length_m 1e-09. load_adapter_basis doi chieu tung khoa nay voi hang so runtime, gom adapter_version, creative_generator_version creative-shape/0.3.0, frame_solver_version frame-f1/0.3.0, claim_ceiling IDEA, design_verdict_authority NONE, va doi chieu adapter_source_sha256 cua basis voi bytes song (a2308d3c8c04ce43... khop). 5/5 artifact tu bam lai khop handoff r001.

Pham vi danh gia: tinh hop le topology va anh xa hinh hoc F0 sang mo hinh F1; che tao, dung sai, van chuyen, cau lap va tiep can kiem tra KHONG duoc danh gia va nam ngoai pham vi F0/F1 IDEA. Do doc lap tren ca ba topology (span 145 m, panel_count 12): DECK_ARCH 26 nut / 37 phan tu / Lmin 6.500000000 m / 2 END_POST; THROUGH_ARCH va NETWORK_ARCH 24 nut / 35 va 46 phan tu / Lmin 10.408776667 m / 0 END_POST, dung chan vom da hop nhat kind ARCH_DECK. Khong topology nao co nut trung toa do va khong phan tu nao zero-length. Anh xa sau edge kind kiem het va dung tuong minh: ARCH_RIB, DECK, SPANDREL, END_POST -> FRAME_2D; HANGER, NETWORK_HANGER -> TRUSS_2D. Goi dung policy: nut trai A0 (ux=True, uy=True, rz=False), nut phai A12 (ux=False, uy=True, rz=False); khong goi nao khoa rz. Cong chan truoc solver bit kin: candidate FAIL (screening_status=REJECTED), candidate UNKNOWN_INPUT_MISSING, sua toa do axis (co va khong reseal candidate_sha256), xoa het canh HANGER lam dut graph, them nut trung toa do, them goi thu ba, bo het goi, them edge kind la CABLE, va ep all_known_pass=false deu bi CreativeFrameAdapterError truoc khi cham solver.

Pham vi danh gia: BC/load traceability, bao toan tai, provenance nguon, toan ven manifest va tinh deterministic. Cac muc khong danh gia vi ngoai pham vi F1: mesh convergence, doi chieu solver doc lap. Bao toan tai: tu tinh tong chieu dai DECK cho ca ba topology deu 145.000000000 m, khop deck_length_m cua adapter; voi q=25 kN/m thi q x L = 3625.000000000 kN va tong tai nut do toi cong lai cung 3625.000000000 kN, sai so tuong doi 0.000e+00; moi tai nut co fx=0 va mz=0 dung huong GLOBAL_NEGATIVE_Y. Provenance profile fail-closed: expected_source_sha256 sai (mo phong source drift) o material lan o deck_line_load, source_ref khong ton tai, backslash Windows, traversal '..', duong tuyet doi, thieu clause_id, clause_id rong, thieu mot edge kind, support_policy khac, candidate_id khong bind, candidate_profile_sha256 khong bind, q_kN_m am, them khoa la, va mot source_ref mang hai digest khac nhau - tat ca 15 ca deu bi chan. Toan ven analysis: sau khi sua roi TU TINH LAI analysis_sha256, validator van phat hien duoc ca 18 phep - sua manifest.model_sha256, manifest.geometry_sha256, tiet dien trong frame_model, tai nut trong frame_model, load_conservation.deck_length_m, chuyen vi trong frame_result, lat mot check F1 PASS->FAIL, doi status adapter khac status F1, sua candidate roi reseal ca hai hash, sua q trong structural_profile, sua basis_hashes, sua adapter_source_digests, bo dong limitation DECK_ARCH roller, nang claim_level, doi design_verdict_authority, them feasible, them design_pass, va dat analysis_sha256 rac. Ban goc thi validate LOT dung nhu mong doi. Deterministic: hai lan chay cho canonical giong byte va cung analysis_sha256. adapter_source_digests neo dung ba file bytes that (creative_frame_adapter.py, creative_shape.py, frame_f1.py). basis_hashes khop candidate.domain_sha256, bytes basis va frame_result.basis_sha256. Schema analysis: 0 lan feasible/verified/design_pass, claim_level const IDEA, design_verdict_authority const NONE, additionalProperties:false o 8 cho, technical_scope F0_CANDIDATE_TO_F1_LINEAR_MODEL_NO_DESIGN_VERDICT. Basis khai ro CONVERGED chi nghia he tuyen tinh F1 hoi tu trong guard applicability va khong phai design verdict. Ghi nhan LOW khong chan duyet: do doc lap cho thay phan luc ngang bang 0 tuyet doi o ca ba topology (phan luc 1812.5/1812.5 kN dung bang dam gian don), tuc DECK_ARCH khong co tac dung vom nao trong mo hinh nay; dieu do da duoc basis khai dung chu va dong limitation do la bat bien duoc bao ve boi hash (bo di thi validator chan). De nghi cai tien cho vong sau: dua chinh tri so phan luc ngang vao output hoac them mot dong limitation rieng theo topology de nguoi doc ha nguon khong doc noi luc vanh vom nhu hanh vi vom.
